name: Don’t Steal the KPop Demon Hunters 🎤
desc:
Welcome to Don’t Steal the KPop Demon Hunters! 🎤

How to Play:
• Sneak up and steal KPop Demon Hunters while they sleep! 😴
• RUN when they wake up and chase you! 🏃
• Take them home and collect tons of cash! 💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more! 🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots! 🏗️
• Trade & gift KPop Demon Hunters with friends to grow together! 🎁
• But be careful... a sleeping KPop Demon Hunter can WAKE at any second! 🤫

Remember, your KPop Demon Hunters earn cash even while you're offline! ⏰

👍 Like the game & join the group for FREE Cash!

**This is a fan-made game.
